visual_action: A static image shows a photo of Donald Trump in a suit, superimposed over a background of two soldiers in military fatigues. Large white text is overlaid on the image, with a red "BREAKING" banner. In the top left corner, there is a small logo that reads "FACT POST".

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A large image of Donald Trump is the central visual element of the post.

cast.name: Selective Service System
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states, "The Selective Service System (SSS) is set to implement the change by December 2026."

on_screen_text.text: MEN AGED 18–25 WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY REGISTERED FOR THE MILITARY DRAFT
The Selective Service System (SSS) is set to implement the change by December 2026.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken audio in the video.
audio_music: A short, looping, gentle, and somewhat melancholic instrumental melody, similar to a music box, plays throughout the clip, creating a somber mood.
manipulation_or_satire: Donald Trump's image is a cutout placed over a separate background photo of soldiers, creating a composite image to visually link him with the military.
central_claim: A policy change by the Selective Service System will automatically register men aged 18-25 for the military draft by December 2026, a development visually associated with Donald Trump.
intended_effect: To alarm viewers, particularly young men, about the prospect of a military draft and to associate this fear with Donald Trump.
